concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-002 specifies a 50 M‑parameter DistilledModel, but the plan describes a “≈ 20 M‑parameter pruned DistilBERT” (see ‘Architecture: Pruned DistilBERT (≈ 20 M parameters)’). This contradicts the specification and violates the single source of truth principle, requiring correction to match the required model size.
